original_context: All humans who value discipline and master techniques cultivate themselves.
If Allan is either serene or finds solace (but not both), then he is at peace.
If Allan seeks wisdom and cultivates himself, then he can practice meditation.
For all humans, if they either have inner peace or are reflected (but not both), then they are serene.
If Allan either feels calm or is agitated (but not both), then he has inner peace.
If Allan practices meditation, then he is either in balance or agitated, but not both.
Allan is either in balance or out of balance, but not both.
conclusion: Allan is not out of balance.
